title: 第2章 连续突破
content_zh:
“小枫。”一道声音传来，只见院落中多出了一位中年，此人身材修长，气息强大，与林枫有几分相似。

“父亲。”此人正是林家家主林海，也是林枫的父亲，灵魂的融合让林枫拥有两人的思想，因此这一声父亲非常的自然，林枫也不觉得有什么不妥。

“小枫，你……好了！”林海面上的线条颤动着，林枫被送回林家的时候奄奄一息，命悬一线，一直处于昏死状态中，林海都已经不抱希望，甚至开始为林枫准备后事，但此刻，他竟然看到一个活生生的儿子出现在自己面前，如何能不喜。

“恩，父亲，我已经完全康复了。”林枫看到林海激动的神色微微一笑，感觉非常温馨，上一世爷爷过世后，他独自面对人情冷暖，就从未享受过这种温馨的感觉。

“好、好。”林海重重的拍了下林枫的肩膀，看着那化为石块粉末的石柱眼中闪过一缕缕精芒，他的那几位兄弟可是都等着他绝后然后好抢夺他的家主之位呢，没想到林枫这么快就恢复了，那帮混蛋一定很失望吧。

就在此时，林海的身上突然散发出阵阵凛冽的寒意，让林枫感觉身体都冻僵了。

“父亲不愧是灵武境的强者，光散发的气息就能将弱者武修冻僵来。”林枫心中暗道一声，武道一途首先是气武境，引天地元气入体，淬炼肉体、锤炼武魂，直到诞生真气，跨入灵武之境，就能够修炼掌握神通法决，一步杀一人，强大无比，林海就是灵武境的强者。

“小枫，是谁干的？”林海面色阴沉，林枫被送回来的时候就奄奄一息，对方是想要林枫的命，而事实上，对方也的确要了那‘林枫’的命。

“父亲，这件事交给孩儿自己解决吧。”林枫没有告诉林海他是被三叔的儿子林恒打伤的，在家族中，他三叔和大伯沆瀣一气，觊觎家主之位，而且无论是实力和势力都不比林海要弱，再加上林恒天赋不错，乃是云海宗外门子弟的佼佼者，因此才敢横行无忌击伤林枫。

这仇，林枫必须自己报，武道一途容不下半点沙子，任何的心魔都是武者变强的障碍。

林海有些意外的看着自己的儿子，只见此时的林枫一改昔日作风，目光坚毅，哪里还看得到半点颓废怯弱。

看来这一次小枫是因祸得福了，林海心中欣慰，点了点头道：“明天随我一起开族会，我倒要看看他们怎么废掉我这族长。”

林家紫竹林中，林枫盘膝在地，身后有着一团黑暗虚影，这虚影几乎完全融于黑夜之中，正是黑暗武魂。

林枫在修炼中发现，在使用黑暗武魂的时候，他的修炼速度要提升五倍不止，因此他不顾精神上的疲惫，一直使用武魂，既然老天给了他重生的机会，他当然要好好的活一回，在九霄大陆，唯有强者，受人尊重，被人敬仰，能够呼风唤雨。

淡淡的乳白色光辉在黑夜中好似一团萤光，包裹着林枫的身体，这是天地元气浓郁到一定程度才会出现的情形。

天赋强者，修炼速度极快，让天地元气聚集在自己身周，形成光圈，而此时的林枫，显然就处于这种状态。

此时的林枫呼吸平稳，面色平静祥和，而体内，天地元气在身体中流动着，溶于血脉，强大筋骨。

良久，一团光芒闪烁，林枫的身体豁然间化作无底洞，瞬息将周身的乳白色的天地元气吞噬入体，干干净净。

睁开眼眸，一缕精芒一闪而逝，宛若掠影流光，林枫站起身来，嘴角浮现一抹笑容，突破了，一夜一境界，此刻的他竟已经到了气武境六重。

不过林枫并没有满足，从记忆中他知道，气武境九重境界不过是武者修炼的起步而已，真正的绝世强者可是能够御空飞行，遨游于九霄云外，那是何等的逍遥洒脱，在前世看来那是属于神仙之辈吧。

想到这林枫开始挥洒他的拳头，拳风呼啸，所指之处翠竹瞬息爆裂炸开，一缕缕强大的空间波浪摧毁着紫竹林。

气武境分九重，每提升一重境界增加千斤巨力，此刻的他是气武境六重修为，拥有六千斤之力，如果使用已经修炼到第六重的九重浪，他就能够发出六千五百斤的强大力量，但在林枫看来这还不够，若是能将九重浪修炼到第七重，一浪猛过一浪，那时他应该能拥有七千斤力量，相当于气武境七重武者拥有的纯力量了。

六千多斤的力量何等刚猛，脆弱的紫竹不断爆裂，整片空间犹如汪洋海浪，只有呼啸的拳风和拳影。

就在这时，远处一根弯曲的翠竹在拳风中竟没有爆裂，而是反弹而回，落在林枫眼中，让他目光一凝，出拳的速度也缓慢了下来。

“九重浪，乃是根据海浪波涛衍化创造出来的武技，一浪强过一浪，霸道刚猛，然而，既是海浪，除了霸道的一面，应该还有他柔和的一面，只有刚柔并济，才能一往无前。”

脑海中灵光一闪，林枫的拳头不再一味的刚猛，而是缓慢递进，时刚时柔。

“喝！”林枫大喝一声，一拳击出。

爆裂之声此起彼伏，六爆、七爆……八爆！

拳风所过之处，紫竹全部化为粉末。

“八重浪，好强。”林枫看到前方的真空深吸口气，停止出拳，领悟了九重浪的精髓，他竟然连续突破两个境界，到达八重浪，要知道，武技修炼到后面越来越难，气武境五重之人能够很容易领悟五重浪，但气武境八重武修却都不一定能使出八重浪，然而林枫却做到了。

“如今我应该拥有七千五百斤的力道了吧，只要领悟到刚柔并济，就是九重浪大成之时。”林枫心头暗喜，武技到后面越来越难修炼，但威力也绝对是成倍递增的，如今的他拥有七千五百斤的强大力量，即使面对气武境七重强者也能一战。

以前的林枫，他连普通的气武境五重武修都打不过，被人瞧不起，而如今林枫来到这世界才一天，就拥有了气武境七重武修的战力，直接跨越了两个境界。
content_en:
"Xiao Feng." A voice came, and a middle-aged man appeared in the courtyard. This man was slender and had a powerful aura, somewhat similar to Lin Feng.

"Father." This man was Lin Hai, the head of the Lin family, and Lin Feng's father. The fusion of souls allowed Lin Feng to have the thoughts of both of them, so the word "father" was very natural, and Lin Feng didn't think there was anything wrong with it.

"Xiao Feng, you...are ready!" The lines on Lin Hai's face trembled. Lin Hai was dying when he was sent back to the Lin family. His life hung on a thread and he was in a coma. Lin Hai had given up hope and even started to prepare for Lin Feng's funeral. But at this moment, he actually saw a living son appearing in front of him. How could he not be happy?

"Well, father, I have fully recovered." Lin Feng smiled slightly when he saw Lin Hai's excited expression. He felt very warm. After his grandfather passed away in his previous life, he had to face the warmth and coldness of human relationships alone, and he had never enjoyed this kind of warm feeling.

"Okay, okay." Lin Hai patted Lin Feng's shoulder heavily, and looked at the stone pillars that turned into stone powder with gleams of light flashing in his eyes. His brothers were all waiting for him to succeed and then snatch his position as the head of the family. He didn't expect Lin Feng to recover so quickly. Those bastards must be very disappointed.

At this moment, Lin Hai's body suddenly emitted waves of freezing coldness, making Lin Feng feel like his body was freezing.

"Father is worthy of being a strong man in the Lingwu Realm. The aura he emits can freeze weak martial artists to death." Lin Feng secretly thought in his heart. The first step in martial arts is the Qiwu Realm, which involves attracting the energy of heaven and earth into the body, tempering the body, and tempering the martial soul until the true energy is born. Once you step into the Lingwu Realm, you can practice and master magical powers, kill one person in one step, and be extremely powerful. Lin Hai is a strong man in the Lingwu Realm.

"Xiao Feng, who did this?" Lin Hai looked gloomy. Lin Feng was dying when he was sent back. The other party wanted Lin Feng's life, and in fact, the other party did want Lin Feng's life.

"Father, let the child resolve this matter by himself." Lin Feng did not tell Lin Hai that he was injured by his third uncle's son Lin Heng. In the family, his third uncle and his eldest uncle colluded and coveted the position of the head of the family, and were no weaker than Lin Hai in terms of strength and power. In addition, Lin Heng was very talented and was the best among the outer disciples of the Yunhai Sect, so he dared to hurt Lin Feng without restraint.

Lin Feng must avenge this revenge by himself. There is no room for any sand in the martial arts. Any inner demons are obstacles for a warrior to become stronger.

Lin Hai looked at his son with some surprise, and saw that Lin Feng had changed his past behavior, his eyes were firm, and there was no trace of decadence or cowardice.

It seemed that this time Xiaofeng was a blessing in disguise. Lin Hai felt happy and nodded: "Come with me to hold a clan meeting tomorrow. I want to see how they abolish me as the clan leader."

In the Lin family's purple bamboo forest, Lin Feng was cross-legged on the ground, with a dark shadow behind him. This shadow was almost completely blended into the night, and it was the dark martial spirit.

During his training, Lin Feng discovered that when using the dark martial spirit, his training speed would be increased by more than five times. Therefore, he continued to use the martial spirit regardless of his mental fatigue. Since God gave him a chance to be reborn, of course he had to live a good life. In Jiuxiao Continent, only the strong, respected and admired by others, could call the wind and rain.

A faint milky white glow was like a ball of fluorescent light in the dark night, wrapping Lin Feng's body. This was a situation that only occurred when the vitality of heaven and earth was strong enough.

A person with strong talent can practice extremely fast, allowing the energy of heaven and earth to gather around him, forming a halo. At this time, Lin Feng was obviously in this state.

At this time, Lin Feng's breathing was steady and his face was calm and peaceful. In his body, the vitality of heaven and earth was flowing in his body, dissolving in his blood and strengthening his muscles and bones.

After a long time, a ball of light flickered, and Lin Feng's body suddenly turned into a bottomless pit, swallowing up all the milky white energy of heaven and earth into his body in an instant, completely.

Opening his eyes, a ray of light flashed away, like a fleeting light. Lin Feng stood up, a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, and he made a breakthrough. He had reached the sixth level of the Qi Martial Realm at this moment.

However, Lin Feng was not satisfied. From his memory, he knew that the ninth level of the Qi Martial Realm was just the beginning of martial arts training. The truly peerless masters could fly in the air and travel beyond the sky. How carefree and free they were. In their previous lives, they must have belonged to gods.

Thinking of this, Lin Feng began to swing his fist, the fist wind howled, and the green bamboo where it was pointed exploded instantly, and powerful space waves destroyed the purple bamboo forest.

The Qi Martial Realm is divided into nine levels, and each level increases the power of a thousand kilograms. At this moment, he is at the sixth level of the Qi Martial Realm and has a power of six thousand kilograms. If he uses the ninth level wave that has been cultivated to the sixth level, he can send out a powerful force of 6,500 kilograms.

The force of more than six thousand kilograms is so fierce. The fragile purple bamboo keeps exploding. The whole space is like a vast ocean wave, with only the whistling wind and shadow of the fist.

At this moment, a curved green bamboo in the distance did not explode in the fist wind, but rebounded back and landed in Lin Feng's eyes, causing his gaze to freeze and the speed of his punches to slow down.

"Nine Waves is a martial art derived from the waves of the ocean waves. Each wave is stronger than the other, domineering and fierce. However, since the waves are not only domineering, they should also have a soft side. Only by combining hardness and softness can we move forward indomitably."

An idea flashed in his mind. Lin Feng's fist was no longer always fierce, but slowly advanced, sometimes hard and sometimes soft.

"Drink!" Lin Feng shouted and punched out.

The sound of explosions came and went, six explosions, seven explosions...eight explosions!

Wherever the fist wind passed, all the purple bamboos turned into powder.

"The eighth level wave is so strong." Lin Feng saw the vacuum in front of him and took a deep breath, stopped punching, and understood the essence of the ninth level wave. He actually broke through two realms in a row and reached the eighth level wave. You know, martial arts training becomes more and more difficult later on. People who are at the fifth level of Qi Martial Realm can easily understand the fifth level wave, but even eighth level martial arts practitioners at the Qi Martial Realm may not be able to use the eighth level wave. However, Lin Feng did it.

"Now I should have a strength of 7,500 kilograms. As long as I understand the combination of hardness and softness, I will reach the peak of the ninth level." Lin Feng was secretly happy. Martial arts will become more and more difficult to practice in the future, but the power will definitely increase exponentially. Now he has a powerful strength of 7,500 kilograms, and he can fight even against the seventh level of Qi Martial Realm.

In the past, Lin Feng couldn't even defeat an ordinary fifth-level martial artist in the Qi Martial Realm and was looked down upon by others. But now, Lin Feng has only been in this world for one day, and he has the combat power of a seventh-level Qi Martial Realm martial artist, directly crossing the two realms.
